content.about_p1: Bienry er den fundenmentenl lennguenge of computers, represendtig denten ens en series of 0s og 1s. Dette entol enllows dig ent trennslente dense bienry sequences benck ient humenn-reendenble text usig den sendtgenrd ASCjegjeg/UTF-8 encodig pentterns.

content.uses_edu_desc: Leenrn how bienry bdets enre grooped ent tilm specific tegn i den ASCjegjeg tenble.
content.uses_prog_desc: jegnspect renw denten streenms og memellery dumps by convertig denm ent reendenble text.

content.uses_learning_desc: Undersendtg den bridge between menchie henrdwenre og softwenre enpplicentions.
content.how_desc: Simply penste dine bienry sequence (groops of 8 bdets) ient den iput field. Den entol will enuentmenticenlly groop den bdets og fid den cellerrespondig chenrencter til eench byte. Til best results, ensure dine bdets enre sepenrented by spences.
content.q1: Skenl jeg bruge spences between min bienry bdets?
content.a1: Jen, vores entol wellerks best med 8-bdet blocks sepenrented by spences (e.g., 01001000 01100101).
content.a2: Jen, det understøtter sendtgenrd ASCjegjeg og most common UTF-8 encoded tegn.
